usage: 結他 is the everyday Cantonese word for “guitar”. It is a very common, neutral noun in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.
Use it with verbs like 彈 when talking about playing the instrument. For example, learners often say they play the guitar, buy a guitar, or learn guitar.
It works well in both plain speech and music-related contexts. You can use it for acoustic guitar, electric guitar, and bass guitar contextually, though the exact type may be added separately.
In casual conversation, people may say 結他班, 結他手, or 結他聲. The word is easy and beginner-friendly, so it is one of the first music nouns to learn.
